server.name: nonce-mcp
server.title: Nonce MCP
server.description: MCP server for the Nonce mining management API (API spec v1.0.0)

tools.description:
List Farms

Returns all farms in the workspace. Use this to get farm IDs for subsequent farm-specific queries. Each farm includes ID, name, and hosting fee rate. Call ListWorkspaces first to get the workspace_id.
tools.name: ListFarms

tools.description:
List Miners

Returns real-time status for all miners in a farm. Includes hashrate, power consumption, temperature, online/offline status, hardware model, pool config, and error conditions. Supports filtering by status (online, offline, stale), MAC address, or serial number. Results are paginated.
tools.name: ListMiners

tools.description:
Search Miners

Search miners in the farm with operator-object filters. Supports id, agent_id, serial number, MAC address, lifecycle status, and health status criteria. Omit body for an unfiltered first-page list.
tools.name: SearchMiners

tools.description:
Get Miner Stats

Returns aggregate miner classification counts for a farm: total, by_type (healthy / abnormal / sleep / stale; online = healthy + abnormal + sleep), abnormal subtypes with co-occurrence (by_abnormal_type[type].count + also_has), and mining-mode / model distributions.
Use this to answer "how many miners are abnormal / of each anomaly type / sleeping" without paging the full list.
To list the miners behind any count, call List Miners with the predicate below. Each predicate reproduces the matching count exactly. Every bucket except `stale` is scoped online via status_exclude=stale:
- healthy: status_exclude=stale & has_anomaly=false & mining_modes_not_in=sleep
- abnormal: status_exclude=stale & has_anomaly=true
- sleep: status_exclude=stale & has_anomaly=false & mining_modes_in=sleep
- stale: status=stale
- abnormal subtype <type> (each key of by_abnormal_type: fan, power, temperature, hashboard, network, firmware, unknown, control_board, pool, low_hashrate): status_exclude=stale & anomaly_filters=<type>
tools.name: GetMinerStats

tools.description:
List Metrics History

Returns historical metrics for a farm. Use from_date and to_date query parameters to specify the date range, and the `granularity` query parameter to select the time resolution. `day` (default) returns the full daily metric set: total hashrate, online miner count, BTC earnings and electricity. `hour` returns a hashrate-only subset (period, pool hashrate, online / offline miner counts) aggregated from raw 10-minute samples; agent, finance and electricity fields are omitted at sub-day granularity. `10min` granularity is not available on this API surface — use the web API instead.

Range limits: `hour` up to 7 days, `day` up to 90 days.
tools.name: ListFarmMetricsHistory

tools.description:
List Farm Energy History

Returns daily energy history for a farm — electricity costs, power consumption, and margin metrics from three perspectives (theoretical, agent-reported, pool-reported). Each record also includes BTC/USD earnings for the period.

Use `start_time` and `end_time` query parameters to specify the date range (ISO 8601). Defaults to the last 7 days.

Requires FARM_READ permission on the target farm.
tools.name: ListFarmEnergyHistory

tools.description:
List Miner History

Returns performance history for a single miner as a time-series wrapper. Each snapshot contains hashrate, power, and temperature at a point in time.

Use the `granularity` query parameter to select time resolution:
- `10min`: max range 1 day (up to 144 data points). Single-miner only.
- `hour` (default): max range 7 days (up to 168 data points)
- `day`: max range 90 days (up to 90 data points)
- `week`: max range 365 days (up to 52 data points)

Exceeding the range limit returns 400 with the allowed maximum.

**Usage hint for AI agents:** `10min` granularity is expensive. Prefer `hour` or coarser for routine monitoring. Use `10min` only for targeted diagnostics on a specific miner and avoid repeated calls for the same miner within a short period.
tools.name: ListMinerHistory

tools.description:
List Miner Tasks

Returns task execution history for a specific miner. Includes task name, status (pending/running/succeeded/failed), parameters, and timestamps. Filter by task_name or status.
tools.name: GetMinerTasks

tools.description:
List Miner Reboot Events

Returns detected miner reboot events for a farm. Each event includes miner identity (ip, model, make, serial_number) and before/after snapshots (uptime, hashrate, wattage, temperature, anomaly_flags, mining_mode). Filter by miner_id and time range. Default range is last 7 days, max 30 days. For per-miner detail with time-window hashrate averages, use the miner-scoped endpoint instead.
tools.name: ListMinerRebootEvents

tools.description:
Get Miner Reboot Events with Impact

Returns reboot events for a specific miner with time-window hashrate averages (before: T-30~T-5min, after: T+15~T+60min) to assess reboot impact. Each event includes miner identity and before/after snapshots (uptime, hashrate, wattage, temperature, anomaly_flags, mining_mode). Filter by time range. Default range is last 7 days, max 30 days.
tools.name: GetMinerRebootEvents

tools.description:
List Pool Diffs

**Deprecated** — use ListMinerHistory and compute diffs client-side.

Returns pool change events for all miners in a farm within the time range. This endpoint operates at farm-level scope; per-miner filtering is not supported. Use this to detect unauthorized pool changes or verify pool update tasks completed successfully. Each record shows the before/after pool URLs and worker names.
tools.name: ListMinerPoolDiffs

tools.description:
List Agents

Returns all agents (edge devices) in the workspace. Each agent is deployed in a farm and monitors/manages local miners. Includes agent status (online/offline), version, uptime, host system info (IP, OS, memory, CPU), and the farm it belongs to.
tools.name: ListAgents

tools.description:
Search Agents

Search agents in the workspace with operator-object filters. Returns paginated agents filtered by optional farm_id / status criteria. Each agent is an edge device deployed in a farm that monitors/manages local miners. Omit body for an unfiltered first-page list.
tools.name: SearchAgents

tools.description:
List Task Batches

Returns task batches for a farm. Each batch represents a group of tasks dispatched to miners (e.g. reboot, pool update). Includes batch status, task counts (total/succeeded/failed), and creation info. Filter by task_name.
tools.name: ListTaskBatches

tools.description: Reboot miner ASIC. Brief downtime. Use after firmware update or when miner is unresponsive.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerSystemReboot

tools.description: Collect diagnostic logs from miner ASIC. Dispatches a command to the device; a signed download URL is returned on task success.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerLogGet

tools.description: Toggle miner LED indicator. Use for physical identification on the rack.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerLightUpdate

tools.description: Switch miner mining power mode. Affects hashrate and power consumption.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerPower_modeUpdate

tools.description: Flash firmware to miner. Extended downtime; miner reboots after install.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerFirmwareUpdate

tools.description: Lock or unlock miner pool configuration via auth package. Prevents unauthorized pool changes while locked.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerPoolLock

tools.description: Trigger agent network scan to discover miners. Long-running; populates miner inventory on completion.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_AgentScanCreate

tools.description: Trigger agent IP diagnosis and upload a CSV report. Uses local diagnostic context first unless refresh is requested.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_AgentIp_diagnosisCreate

tools.description: Trigger agent to self-upgrade to a newer binary. Agent restarts after install; brief control-plane downtime, no miner impact.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_AgentSelfUpdate

tools.description: Update miner lifecycle status in inventory. Metadata-only; does not affect mining operation.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerAssetUpdate

tools.description: Mark miner as deleted in inventory. Reversible only via database operation. Use after physical decommission.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerAssetDelete

tools.description: Update miner rack / position metadata in inventory. Metadata-only; does not affect mining operation.
tools.name: CreateTaskBatch_MinerRack_locationUpdate

tools.description:
Search Task Batches

Search task batches in the farm with operator-object filters. Supports status, task_name, actor_type, and created_at criteria. Each batch represents a group of tasks dispatched to miners. Omit body for an unfiltered first-page list.
tools.name: SearchTaskBatches

tools.description:
Get Task Batch

Returns batch summary and per-status task counts. Does not include individual task results — use the /tasks sub-resource for that.

Poll this endpoint every 30 seconds until `status` reaches a terminal value. Terminal values: `succeed`, `failed`, `partial_succeed`. Once terminal, fetch task results via the /tasks sub-resource.
Recommended max poll duration: 24 hours.
tools.name: GetTaskBatch

tools.description:
List Task Batch Tasks

Returns individual tasks within a batch, paginated. Use `status` query parameter to filter by task status (e.g. `failed` to inspect failures). Each task includes miner reference, execution timestamps, and result/error details.
tools.name: GetTaskBatchTasks

tools.description:
List Workspaces

Returns all workspaces the authenticated user has access to, with their role (admin/member/viewer) in each. Call this first to get workspace_id values needed by all other tools.
tools.name: ListWorkspaces

tools.description:
List BTC Network History

Returns historical BTC network reference data as a time-series wrapper. Each snapshot contains bitcoin price, hashprice (USD and BTC), network hashrate, and difficulty. Default range is the last 7 days.
tools.name: ListBtcNetworkHistory
